description: End-to-end lifecycle management of network alarms in a telecom assurance system, including detection, correlation, assignment, suppression, resolution, and audit.

alarm_id.description: Unique identifier of a single alarm instance

alarm_group_id.description: Identifier for a correlated group of related alarms (incident/problem ticket)

suppression_rule_id.description: Identifier of an alarm suppression rule

operator_id.description: Identifier of an operator or automation bot handling alarms

network_location.description: Location of the network element raising the alarm

site_id.description: Identifier of the physical site (e.g., cell site, data center)

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: ingest_alarm_event
functions.description: Ingest a raw alarm event from the network into the assurance system, performing normalization and deduplication.

external_alarm_id.description: Alarm identifier in the source system

event_time.description: Timestamp when the alarm was generated by the network element

probable_cause.description: Free-text cause from the NE, typically ITU-T X.733 probable cause

alarm_code.description: Vendor specific alarm code or mnemonic

correlation_keys.description: Keys used for deduplication and correlation

lifecycle_state.description: Whether this event is a raise or clear notification

functions.returns: Created or updated alarm with internal alarm_id, deduplication info and current status.

functions.name: get_alarm
functions.description: Retrieve detailed information for a single alarm by alarm_id, including history, correlations, and suppression state.

include.description: Additional sections to include in the response

functions.returns: Complete alarm record including current attributes, status, correlation/group info, suppression info, and optionally history/audit.

functions.name: search_alarms
functions.description: Search and list alarms with multi-dimensional filters for operations dashboards and bulk actions.

query.description: Free-text search on alarm code, probable cause, notes, etc.

functions.returns: List of alarms matching the filters, with summary fields, total count, and paging information.

functions.name: correlate_alarms
functions.description: Create or update a correlated alarm group (incident) based on correlation rules or manual grouping.

alarm_ids.description: Alarms to be considered for correlation

existing_alarm_group_id.description: If provided, alarms will be added to/merged with this group

operator_id.description: Operator requesting manual correlation, if strategy is 'manual'

functions.returns: Alarm group with alarm_group_id, list of member alarms, group severity, and correlation rationale.

functions.name: acknowledge_alarms
functions.description: Acknowledge one or more alarms or an entire alarm group, updating ownership and status.

scope.description: Whether to acknowledge specific alarms or all alarms in a group

ownership.description: Optional ownership info to assign along with acknowledgement

assigned_to.description: Operator or team ID the alarms are assigned to

queue.description: Operations queue or domain (e.g., RAN, Core, IP, Transmission)

functions.returns: Updated alarms with new status, acknowledgement timestamps, and ownership details.

functions.name: update_alarm_status
functions.description: Transition alarms through their lifecycle (in_progress, resolved, closed) with resolution details when applicable.

closure_reason.description: Free-text or coded closure reason for moving to closed state

customer_tickets.description: Optional linkage to customer-facing trouble tickets

functions.returns: Lifecycle transition result for each alarm, including any validation errors or conflicts.

functions.name: create_suppression_rule
functions.description: Create a new suppression rule to automatically hide or de-prioritize alarms matching certain conditions.

name.description: Human readable name of the suppression rule

time_of_day.description: Optional time window during the day when rule is active

functions.returns: Created suppression rule with suppression_rule_id, evaluation summary, and potential conflicts with existing rules.

functions.name: list_suppression_rules
functions.description: List existing suppression rules with filtering, for audit and configuration management.

search_text.description: Free-text search across rule name and description

functions.returns: List of suppression rules with metadata, including suppression_rule_id, status, and summary of conditions.

functions.name: update_suppression_rule
functions.description: Update or disable an existing suppression rule and optionally re-evaluate impacted alarms.

updates.description: Fields to update in the rule

re_evaluate_existing_alarms.description: If true, re-applies the rule to currently active alarms

re_evaluation_scope.description: Optional scope for re-evaluation if enabled

functions.returns: Updated suppression rule, plus summary of re-evaluation impact if requested (number of alarms affected, errors).

functions.name: retry_alarm_action
functions.description: Retry an automated action previously attempted on an alarm (e.g., auto-clear, script execution) and handle failures.

action_id.description: Identifier of the previously executed action to retry

reason.description: Reason for manual retry (e.g., 'script fixed', 'temporary network issue resolved')

functions.returns: Retry execution status including success/failure, logs, number of attempts, and suggested next steps if still failing.

functions.name: rollback_alarm_status
functions.description: Rollback an alarm status to a previous lifecycle state in case of erroneous resolution or closure, maintaining full audit.

reason.description: Reason for rollback, including reference to any incorrect operations

restore_previous_resolution_info.description: If true, restores previous resolution info associated with the target status

functions.returns: Updated alarm with rolled back status, and an audit entry describing the rollback operation.

functions.name: delete_alarm
functions.description: Permanently delete or purge an alarm (or logically mark as archived) from the system, typically used for GDPR or test data cleanup.

mode.description: Logical delete flags the alarm as archived; physical delete removes it permanently.

force.description: If true, bypasses safety checks such as unresolved tickets linkage (where allowed by policy).

functions.returns: Deletion result indicating success, mode applied, and any cascading impacts (e.g., alarm group updates).

functions.name: get_alarm_timeline
functions.description: Retrieve a chronological timeline of all events, status changes, actions, and annotations for an alarm or alarm group for audit and RCA.
functions.returns: Ordered list of timeline events with timestamps, actor, event type, and detailed payload for each change impacting the alarm or group.

functions.name: alarm_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import alarm entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: alarm_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many alarm entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: alarm_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many alarm entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: alarm_bulk_export
functions.description: Export alarm entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: alarm_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across alarm entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: alarm_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for alarm events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: alarm_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for alarm notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: alarm_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more alarm entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: alarm_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to alarm on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: alarm_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a alarm operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: alarm_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending alarm change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: alarm_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending alarm approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: alarm_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a alarm entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: alarm_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a alarm entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: alarm_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a alarm entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: alarm_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a alarm entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: alarm_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for alarm activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: alarm_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a alarm view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: alarm_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to alarm entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: alarm_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given alarm payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: alarm_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a alarm entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: alarm_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a alarm entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
